definitions.explanation: The transfer of heat through a material by direct contact between molecules, without bulk movement of the material itself. One of the three main modes of heat transfer, alongside convection and radiation.

examples.japanese: {金属|きんぞく}は{導熱|どうねつ}{性|せい}が{高|たか}い。
{導熱|どうねつ}{率|りつ}の{低|ひく}い{素材|そざい}は{断熱材|だんねつざい}に{適|てき}している。
examples.english: Materials with low thermal conductivity are suitable for insulation.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}の{壁|かべ}を{通|つう}じた{導熱|どうねつ}を{抑|おさ}えることが、{省|しょう}エネルギー{住宅|じゅうたく}の{設計|せっけい}で{重要|じゅうよう}なポイントとなる。
examples.english: Reducing heat conduction through building walls is an important point in the design of energy-efficient houses.

notes:
A compound of {導|どう} (conduct/guide) and {熱|ねつ} (heat). Describes the physical process by which heat moves through a material from a region of higher temperature to one of lower temperature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {導熱|どうねつ}{性|せい}: thermal conductivity
- {導熱|どうねつ}{率|りつ}: thermal conductivity coefficient
- {導熱|どうねつ}{材|ざい}: heat-conducting material

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {熱伝導|ねつでんどう}: heat conduction (more common term, same meaning)
- {伝熱|でんねつ}: heat transfer (broader term including conduction, convection, and radiation)
- {対流|たいりゅう}: convection (heat transfer through fluid movement)
- {放射|ほうしゃ}: radiation (heat transfer through electromagnetic waves)
